title: Scheduler
description: Cron schedules for agent threads. Every scheduler.cron trigger instance is bound to a thread and fires it when its cron expression is due, evaluated in the organization timezone. Missed runs follow the selected policy: catch up within an hour, skip, or skip and open an approval inbox item.

permissions.reason: Fire scheduler.cron instances when their cron expression is due
Stay running so the planner keeps firing due schedules
Evaluate cron times in the organization timezone
Resolve a schedule target agent by name or id
Create a dedicated thread when a schedule targets another agent
Open approval inbox items when a schedule misses its catch-up window

descriptor.title: Cron schedule
descriptor.description: Run an agent on a cron schedule

options.label: Catch up
options.help: Runs missed while the host was asleep still fire within the next hour.

options.label: Skip
options.help: Missed runs are dropped; the next scheduled run fires as usual.

options.label: Skip and ask
options.help: Missed runs are dropped and an approval inbox item asks what to do.

descriptor.name: scheduler
descriptor.title: Scheduler tools
descriptor.description: Inspect and manage this addon's cron schedules: list, pause and resume

tools.name: list
tools.description: List this addon's cron schedules: name, cron expression, miss policy, status, next run, last fire, target thread, target agent and instructions.

tools.name: set
tools.description: Create a cron schedule (omit schedule) or update an existing one (schedule = instance id or name). The cron expression is evaluated in the organization timezone; optional miss_policy controls missed runs (catch-up, skip, escalate). By default the schedule fires in the calling agent's thread; pass agentId or agent to target another agent, optionally with threadId to bind a specific thread of that agent. Pass instructions to tell the agent what to do on every fire; they are shown and editable in the trigger settings. Pass workspace (an absolute folder path) to make that folder the working directory of the schedule thread (chat threads only): every fire, and every manual message in that thread, run there.

schedule.description: Schedule instance id or name to update; omit to create

instructions.description: What the agent should do on every fire; shown and editable in the trigger settings

threadId.description: Thread to fire; create defaults to the calling thread, update keeps the current binding when omitted

agentId.description: Target agent id; overrides the calling agent so the schedule fires for another agent

agent.description: Target agent name, resolved to an agent id; use when the id is unknown

workspace.description: Absolute folder path the target thread runs in (schedule fires and manual messages)

tools.name: pause
tools.description: Pause a schedule by instance id or name: the planner stops firing it until it is resumed.

tools.name: resume
tools.description: Resume a paused schedule by instance id or name: the next run is recomputed from the cron expression in the organization timezone.
